text:
ana: Mango update! She discovered the hanging hammock and refuses to sleep anywhere else now. It's like a tiny orange hammock fort. (pic attached) :tangerine:

rico: omg hammock queen :crown: that side-eye while suspended is iconic

tara: please name the hammock. Mango deserves a dignified title.

mike: vote time: 1) The Mango Hammock 2) Sir Nap-a-Lot 3) Hammock Houdini. react 1/2/3 or reply other.

ana: (typo correction) ana: 1 for legacy branding :tangerine: :raised_hands:

rico: 3. she does a daily stealth dismount and reappears five minutes later like nothing happened.

bot-photo: ana added a file: mango-hammock-01.jpg (820KB)

tara: pro tip for anyone who wants one: i used a macrame window hammock and added velcro tabs. setup was basically `zip tie + velcro loop` to anchor to the sill, no drilling.

mike: adding a recurring "Mango Monday" calendar invite for low-commit photo drops. who wants to be invited?

ana: ana: yes please! she'll accept treats as bribes and will perform approximately one dramatic yawn per appearance. :yum_cat:

rico: sending our admiration and a tiny doodle crown.
